entities.name: Eln Forest
entities.description: Forest in northwestern Terisiare during the Dark Age, home to Ironroot treefolk and elves, later destroyed by the Great Glacier.

entities.name: Sacumon
entities.description: Sorceress whose schemes brought the elves into conflict with the Urhaalan minotaurs.

entities.name: Urhaalan minotaurs
entities.description: Minotaurs of the Urhaalan Valley in conflict with the Eln Forest elves.

entities.name: Istvan
entities.description: Hermit who became an axe murderer in Eln Forest.

entities.name: Great Glacier
entities.description: Widening glacier that covered Eln Forest at the onset of the Ice Age.

events.summary: Elves of Eln Forest came into conflict with the Urhaalan minotaurs through the schemes of Sacumon.
